questions.subject: Art & Model Drawing
questions.question_text: Which approach best supports effective work in Introduction to Art and Drawing?

options.text: Use visual choices deliberately to support the intended idea
Ignore proportion, context and audience
Copy an existing work exactly
Treat every material and technique as identical

questions.answer: Use visual choices deliberately to support the intended idea

questions.subject: Art & Model Drawing
questions.question_text: Name two important considerations when studying or practising Introduction to Art and Drawing.
questions.answer: Any two well-explained considerations connected to line, shape, form, tone, texture and observation, with clear relevance to the chapter context.

questions.subject: Art & Model Drawing
questions.question_text: Explain how visual decisions in Introduction to Art and Drawing can combine skill, meaning and context.
questions.answer: A strong answer should discuss at least three relevant dimensions from line, shape, form, tone, texture and observation, explain how they interact, and connect technique with purpose or context without copying a textbook passage or artwork.
